'''2001 Brugge Belgian Open Team Event''' was a Star Wars CCG team held in Brugge, Belgium on 4 March 2001. The Four Musketeers (team: [[Julien Riviere]], [[Jimmy Faelens]], [[Fabien Jacques]], [[Christophe Vandalem]]) won it. It is known from Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1849">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-06-decipher-week-end-brugge-belgium-day-2d1849/ decipher-week-end-brugge-belgium-day-2], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 6 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-06-decipher-week-end-brugge-belgium-day-2d1849/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Brugge Belgian Open]].

* '''Date:''' 4 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Brugge, Belgium
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' The Four Musketeers (team: [[Julien Riviere]], [[Jimmy Faelens]], [[Fabien Jacques]], [[Christophe Vandalem]])
